note: The input is parsed as SSML and forwarded into tag processing.
The audio src attribute is copied into a fixed-size local buffer.
The code assumes the copied path fits in buf before using it to build a file path; the safety obligation is that the copied attribute length stays within the destination buffer.
A long attacker-controlled src value can overflow the 256-byte fname buffer during path construction.
